name: OG Lethal Ape‎
summary:
OG Lethal Ape drops you into a cold, abandoned facility where something has gone horribly wrong. Harsh fluorescent lights buzz overhead, concrete walls close in around you, and empty rooms feel watched—even when they’re silent. What was once a controlled environment is now a hunting ground.

Movement is entirely physics-based, inspired by Gorilla Tag. You don’t run with buttons—you move with your body. Push off walls, crawl through tight spaces, vault across rooms, and desperately climb to safety using only
